title: Purchase order (with a changing clock)
note: expected = result with NO zone applied (FAIL on the timestamp). ignoreZones = the zone to draw or load, in baseline px; with it the same pair must PASS with 0 regions.
story: Nothing real changed; only the 'Last updated' clock is different. Shows how to tell the inspector to ignore a clock.
whatToExpect: Expect: 1 small change (FAIL), then PASS after you ignore the clock.
group: How the inspector handles tricky cases

title: Employee job record (different screen scale)
note: Capture-standard violation demo: the after image was captured at 1.1× device scale. The inspector detects the scale (resize ≈ 0.91) but resampled text still differs; the app hints 'Likely capture artifact'. Fix: recapture both at the same device scale (docs/erp/capture-standards.md).
story: The after screenshot was taken at a different screen scale, which breaks the capture rules, so expect lots of tiny false changes.
whatToExpect: Expect: many tiny changes (FAIL). This is a bad capture, not a real problem; retake both at the same scale.
group: How the inspector handles tricky cases
